data.title: Refusal of moving container permit
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's public order office (Ordnungsamt) rejected your application of 2 July 2026 for a special use permit to place a moving container in front of Lindenweg 12. The reason given is that the pavement is only 1.40 m wide.
data.explanation: The city has refused your permit for the container on the public pavement, because it says pedestrians could not pass safely. You may decide to challenge this by filing a court action (Klage) at the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht). No objection procedure comes first. The app shows until when you can file. The action must be in writing or recorded at the court registry. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final. You could consider legal advice, and you should not place the container without a permit.

items.title: File court action against refusal
items.action: If you want to challenge the refusal, file a court action (Klage) in writing, or have it recorded at the court registry, at the Administrative Court of Musterstadt (Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt).
items.consequence: After the deadline the refusal becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

date.text: binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
